hints.title: Street Side Independence
hints.text: The placements of houses on the north side and south side are completely independent.

hints.title: Single Side Fibonacci Recurrence
hints.text: For one side with n plots, if f(n) is the number of valid placements, f(n) = f(n - 1) + f(n - 2) with f(1) = 2 and f(2) = 3.

hints.title: Squaring Total Combinations
hints.text: The total ways for both sides is (f(n) * f(n)) modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Fibonacci Square Implementation

variables: n: number of plots on each side
complexity.notes: Linear scan computing Fibonacci values in constant variables.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory by keeping only the last two Fibonacci values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes independence of north and south sides and applies squaring.
